name: deepseek_runtime_status
description: Check the local DSH runtime, available models and agent presets without creating a session or running a model.

name: deepseek_flash
description: Run the latest official deepseek-flash model as a native, continuable DSH child agent and return its final answer. New calls are grouped below one Codex coordination session per workspace.

task.description: Self-contained task for the DeepSeek Flash subagent.

cwd.description: Workspace directory. Defaults to the desktop app workspace.

session_id.description: Continue a previous native DSH child agent.

max_output_tokens.description: Per-model-request reasoning plus visible-output cap, not the task total. Defaults to the provider maximum. Omit unless the user needs a specific per-response limit.

unlimited_output_tokens.description: Use the host safety ceiling (393216); it is not truly unbounded. Cannot be combined with max_output_tokens.

max_tool_calls.description: Optional per-turn tool-call limit. Omit or use -1 for no count limit. 0 disables every tool. Do not invent a small quota unless the user requests one.

allow_terminal.description: Expose pwsh/bash to this child. False removes it before the model request and also blocks execution.

finalize_empty.description: If reasoning exhausts the budget with no visible answer, run one bounded no-tool conclusion pass.

return_reasoning.description: Return DSH-visible DeepSeek reasoning chunks in addition to the final result.

wait_for_completion.description: False returns the native session id immediately; poll deepseek_flash_status for live progress.

max_requests.description: Optional shared model-request limit; omit or -1 for no plugin count limit. Positive values enforce an explicitly chosen budget.

max_total_output_tokens.description: Optional cumulative output cap (reasoning plus visible text); omit or -1 for no plugin total cap. Finite values must be at least 64. Do not add a small cap merely to delegate work.

max_total_input_tokens.description: Optional cumulative input cap; omit or -1 for no plugin total cap. Finite limits reserve the provider context capacity for in-flight calls.

max_cost_micros.description: Cost admission cap in micro-units of the administrator-configured pricing currency. Requires a trusted pricing registry; not an invoice guarantee.

allow_external_writes.description: Explicitly permit registered external-write tools selected in allowed_tools. Read-only policy still denies them.

max_tool_calls_total.description: Optional shared tool-call limit; omit or -1 for no count limit. 0 denies all tools.

max_duration_seconds.description: Optional deadline from original task creation; omit or -1 for no plugin deadline. Positive seconds cooperatively cancel generation/tools; not an OS kill boundary.

allowed_tools.description: Narrow built-in capabilities and explicitly select administrator-registered third-party tools. Unknown names never grant access.

continue_until_answer.description: Continue interrupted responses or preambles through the native task inbox until an answer or explicit blocker. User cancellation, errors, explicit budgets and repeated no-progress still stop the task.

max_transcript_tokens.description: Plugin continuation threshold. Set 0 to let native DSH compaction and the provider manage the context.

request_key.description: Submission idempotency key. Reuse the exact task, target and policy to retrieve the same receipt; use a new key for a genuinely new turn.

name: deepseek_flash_status
description: Read the current state, final answer, and token/cache usage of a DeepSeek Flash subagent session.

name: deepseek_flash_stop
description: Stop the active turn of a DeepSeek Flash subagent session.

name: deepseek_lead

task.description: Project task for the Codex Lead.

cwd.description: Required workspace for a new Lead; validated when continuing.

lead_id.description: Continue an existing Codex Lead session.

name.description: Optional custom display name for a new Lead (Unicode supported, no control characters or blank-only names). Omit for Codex Lead N. Identity is persisted role metadata; continue by lead_id after renaming.

max_tool_calls.description: Optional per-turn tool-call limit. Omit or use -1 for no count limit. 0 disables every tool. Do not invent a small quota unless the user requests one.

child_policy.description: Host-enforced policy for every native child created by this Lead. Defaults to Flash, read-only, no terminal, and no further delegation.

model.description: Exact child model. Keep Flash unless the user explicitly requests Pro.

name: deepseek_lead_status
description: Read a Codex Lead result, token/cache usage, and its direct DSH child-agent results.

name: deepseek_lead_list
description: List persistent Codex Lead sessions, optionally limited to one workspace.

name: deepseek_lead_stop
description: Stop a running Codex Lead turn and close its task lease.

name: deepseek_session_archive
description: Archive one settled session, or explicitly restore its archive status. Native archive blocks subagent descendants. Restore changes only the named session and never prompts or replays work.

name: deepseek_tasks_wait
description: Wait for existing DSH sessions and their descendants. Read-only: never resumes agents or creates messages. A timeout returns pending IDs, not completion.

name: deepseek_task_result
description: Read the current result in bounded pages, including partial output and an exact turn identity. Does not run a model or mutate the session.

expected_turn.description: Reject if the session advanced since the previous page.

expected_revision.description: Result revision from the previous page; detects live text changes.

include_task.description: Include the original submitted task and effective policy. Does not read unrelated parent conversations.

name: deepseek_tasks_list
description: List managed Direct, Lead and child tasks without creating or waking sessions.

name: deepseek_task_tree
description: Read the full durable task family, including archived/missing children, exact receipt/turn IDs and recovery state. Does not wake, reconcile or execute any agent.

name: deepseek_task_cancel
description: Request cancellation of a managed task, optionally including descendants. Cancellation acknowledgement is not proof of quiescence; wait afterward.

name: deepseek_tasks_start
description: Start up to eight independent Direct tasks and return their handles. Each item must have a stable request_key. Partial batch failures do not replay successful items. Join with deepseek_tasks_wait.

name: deepseek_capabilities
description: Inspect actual DSH plugin tools, pinned schemas and effective task permissions. Read-only; never wakes an agent, grants capabilities, executes tools or imports Codex-only plugins. A cold session returns unknown availability.

name: deepseek_watch
description: Persist a zero-model periodic task report in the DSH runtime. This does not itself wake Codex; use an explicitly authorized host heartbeat to consume notifications.

name: deepseek_notifications
description: Read durable bounded reports, replay after disconnection, or list channels. Reading never acknowledges or generates model calls. Check gap before consuming.

name: deepseek_notifications_ack
description: Acknowledge through a sequence ONLY after its report has been delivered. Cursor is per consumer; no task is cancelled or resumed.

name: deepseek_schedule_create
description: Authorize native DSH to continue an existing root Lead at a specified time or recurring interval. Captures its current policy and retains its cumulative budget; cannot target a child. Requires an explicit user scheduling request. Backend must be running; no Codex timer is created.

at.description: Absolute RFC3339 instant with Z or explicit UTC offset; never infer a timezone.

expires_at.description: Absolute RFC3339 end of authorization (explicit Z/offset). No admission or continued execution at/after it.

max_lateness_seconds.description: Maximum admission delay after each native occurrence, default 300 seconds. Late occurrences are consumed as expired, never replayed.

name: deepseek_schedule_list
description: Read Collab-owned native DSH schedules, next delivery, and execution states without waking a Lead. Does not list or alter Codex reminders.

name: deepseek_schedule_update
description: Compare-and-update a Collab native schedule. Get revision from list first. Explicit refresh_policy re-authorizes the current Lead policy; otherwise policy changes block future execution. An inactive one-shot needs a new create, not replay.

at.description: Absolute RFC3339 instant with Z or explicit UTC offset; never infer a timezone.

expires_at.description: Absolute RFC3339 end of authorization (explicit Z/offset). No admission or continued execution at/after it.

max_lateness_seconds.description: Maximum admission delay after each native occurrence, default 300 seconds. Late occurrences are consumed as expired, never replayed.

name: deepseek_schedule_delete
description: Cancel a Collab native schedule and reject its not-yet-admitted queued deliveries. An already running Lead is NOT interrupted; use task_cancel separately if authorized. Keeps bounded execution audit, not native delivery history.

name: deepseek_schedule_history
description: Read bounded execution audit plus native delivery receipts. Delivery acknowledgement is not execution success. Unknown outcomes after a crash are never blindly replayed.

name: deepseek_task_reconcile
description: Inspect or recover an interrupted task in the same session, preserving completed children, native history, files and cumulative budgets. Recover prepares safe continuation without model execution or replay; unknown side effects require verified tool_resolutions. Abandon is only for explicitly unwanted work, never required for ordinary recovery.

name: deepseek_task_trace
description: Read native visible execution history: user tasks, intermediate assistant output, tool inputs/results and turn endings. Read-only, no wakeup or reasoning disclosure. Uses a stable sequence cursor; long individual records have explicit text offsets.
